title: Face close-ups and faithful motions
description: Customizable avatar shortcuts, Meshy motion corrections and independent action permissions.
highlights: Cmd+Shift+9 frames the avatar’s face. Cmd+Shift+0 restores normal size and placement. Customize both in Settings.
Action Engine & Permissions follows the reasoning agent by default, with an optional separate action engine.
Restored original body movement in Meshy presets, including Bubble Dance and Boxing Warm-up, without changing character geometry.
Added Backflip, 360 Power Spin Jump and All Night Dance for all five characters.
Encrypted motion updates reuse existing model and texture downloads.
